title: Onboard GHL Voice AI Agents
subtitle: Complete guide to integrate Go High Level Voice AI agents with Knotie AI Pro

prerequisites.title: Prerequisites
items: Active Go High Level account with Voice AI capabilities
Knotie AI Pro partner account with API key access

steps.title: Create API Key
steps.description: First, you need to create an API key in your Knotie AI Pro partner dashboard.
instructions: Navigate to Settings → API Keys in your partner dashboard
Give it a name like "GHL Voice AI Integration"
Copy and save the API key securely

steps.title: Configure GHL Workflow
steps.description: Set up a workflow in Go High Level to send webhook data after each voice AI call.
workflowSteps: Go to Automations → Workflows in your GHL account
Create a new workflow or edit existing one
Set trigger to "Voice AI Call Completed"
Configure webhook with the details below

steps.title: Custom Data Configuration
steps.description: Configure the custom data that will be sent with each webhook. This data is crucial for proper tracking and billing.
importantNotes: Replace yellow highlighted values with your actual data
Use the same partner email as your Knotie AI Pro account
agent_id should be unique for each voice AI agent
base_per_minute_cost is in cents (10 = $0.10 per minute)

steps.title: Test Your Integration
steps.description: Test your integration to ensure everything is working correctly.
testingSteps: Make a test call using your GHL Voice AI agent
Check your GHL workflow logs for webhook delivery
Verify the agent appears in your Knotie AI Pro dashboard
Check analytics data is being recorded
successIndicators: Agent appears in GHL Voice AI Agents page
Credits are deducted from your balance

support.title: Need Help?
support.description: If you encounter any issues during setup, our support team is here to help.
